Messages.Author: Malcolm McCallum
Messages.Body:
I expect this has already been answered but, if I use Increased Strength
and then throw down a Shattering Blow as my strike, does it destroy the
equipment AND still do 2 damage (assuming superior)? If it does, does it
get first strike?

Messages.Author: Alec Chang
Messages.Body:

> get first strike?Ahem. In the rules(I think) and in the errata; "any strike which does
not do damage will not do damage even when cards which increase damage to
a strike are played". This includes lucky blow, Increased strength, and
+1 hand damage on vampires.

Alec Chang

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Malcolm McCallum <mcca...@pacificcoast.net> writes:

>I expect this has already been answered but, if I use Increased Strength
>and then throw down a Shattering Blow as my strike, does it destroy the
>equipment AND still do 2 damage (assuming superior)? If it does, does it
>get first strike?

By the ruling on Rowan Ring, I would have to say "No".

Any strike that doesn't deal damage cannot be modified for +X damage.
